name: Admin status report
description: Displays site status reports and reminders based on predefined permissions.
project_description:
The Admin Status Report module displays messages to users with certain permissions for

important status-related information such as if there are errors or warnings on

the core status page.

 Post-Installation 
 Configure user permissions in Administration » People » Permissions:

 Administer admin status messages

Users in roles with this permission can configure which Admin Status messages shown.

 Customize the Admin Status settings at Administration » Configuration » System » Admin Status Report.
